scope: Replay the supplied original bento image twice through the production vision prompt and strict parser, then ground the exact saved normalized results offline against local official datasets. No production app route, FDC/Tavily provider, or production database.

observations.repeatability: Same image and prompt produced 7 items in both runs, but ordering, rice/chicken weights, weight confidence, vegetable naming and several preparation fields differed. This is qualitative instability from two calls, not a calibrated accuracy estimate.
observations.pending_section_cause: No item fell below the configured 0.45 vision threshold in either replay. Pending/unmatched behavior in these two results comes from missing or incompatible local nutrition matches, not a low-confidence threshold rejection.
observations.confidence_limit: Model self-rated confidence is not calibrated correctness; weight confidence was only 0.35-0.60, with no weighed ground truth.

bounded_repairs.generic_name_with_location: Added finite visual-region suffix handling so 葉菜（左上格） and 葉菜（右下） remain generic and cannot qualify for FDC/web fallback. Specific labels with the same suffix, such as 青江菜（左上格）, remain eligible for existing checks. Original stored names are unchanged.
bounded_repairs.cooked_white_rice: Exact TFDA A0550601 record is cooked white rice prepared in an electric rice cooker, but has no method enum. The existing schema's nearest reviewed `steamed` compatibility applies only to key 白飯 plus exact source/code/name/description; other method choices and altered records remain incompatible. This is an enum compatibility, not source-supplied method metadata.
bounded_repairs.diagnostic_tool: Live photo probe now uses production strict JSON parsing, accepted finish policy and detected image MIME; it preserves raw text and pre-normalized JSON for audit.
